data.long_meaning: Ishanvi is derived from the name Ishan, which means god or ruler in Sanskrit. In Hinduism, Ishan is one of the five directions and the presiding deity of the north. Ishanvi can also represent the sun god, Surya, who is believed to be the source of all energy and life. The name Ishanvi carries the meaning “God, ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ishanvi usually hope their child will grow to embody god, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
